philippians.2.p1.b1.text: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

philippians.2.p1.b2.text: … by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

philippians.2.p2.b1.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

philippians.2.p2.b2.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

philippians.2.p3.b1.text: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

philippians.2.p3.b2.text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped, but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.

philippians.2.p3.b3.text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.

philippians.2.p4.b1.text: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

philippians.2.p4.b2.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

philippians.2.p4.b3.text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

philippians.2.p5.b1.text: … continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling. For it is God who works in you to will and to act …

philippians.2.p5.b2.text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,

philippians.2.p5.b3.text: … in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world

philippians.2.p6.b1.text: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad …

philippians.2.p6.b2.text: … and rejoice with all of you.

philippians.2.p6.b3.text: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.

philippians.2.p7.b1.text: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, …

philippians.2.p7.b2.text: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.

philippians.2.p7.b3.text: … as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.

philippians.2.p7.b4.text: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

philippians.2.p8.b1.text: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, …

philippians.2.p8.b2.text: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

philippians.2.p8.b3.text: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death.

philippians.2.p8.b4.text: But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

philippians.2.p9.b1.text: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, …

philippians.2.p9.b2.text: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,

philippians.2.p9.b3.text: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life …
